[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Model aliases in the %model completion menu[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Typing `%m:` / `%model:` shows model aliases as unmistakable, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]richly annotated rows beneath the concrete model names, each [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]prompt input and in editors through the xprompt LSP.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fix the `@` alias gate in the prompt-input directive grammar[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]already-correct sase-core grammar.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Enrich the model completion catalog with alias resolution and [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]extend the LSP catalog JSON additively.[/#D7D7AF]
